Transcription with verbose JSON response format including timestamp segments

```elixir title="Elixir"
api_key = System.fetch_env!("API_KEY")
{:ok, client} = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = LiterLlm.defaultclient_transcribe_async(client, "{\"file\":\"audio.mp3\",\"model\":\"whisper-1\",\"response_format\":\"verbose_json\"}")
IO.inspect(result.text)
IO.inspect(result.segments)
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.segments, 0).id)
```
